description: Implementation of a service class for reading note data from a database in the Fineract project, including methods for retrieving individual notes and lists of notes based on resource types, with internal mapping and SQL query construction.

classes.name: NoteReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing note retrieval logic using JDBC, including internal mapping and SQL query construction.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to NoteData objects.

methods.name: retrieveNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, resource ID, and note type, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNotesByResource
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with a specific resource ID and note type.

methods.name: getResourceCondition
methods.description: Constructs SQL condition string based on note type and appends relevant parameters.
